flows:
Navigate to http://localhost:4173 then Set the Widget quantity to 1 and leave the Gadget quantity at 0.
Type buyer@example.com into the Email field and click Place order.
Verify a message containing 'Order confirmed' is shown.

remark: type: Setting the Widget quantity to 1
type: Typing buyer@example.com into the Email field
click: Clicking Place order button below the Email field
wait: Waiting after placing the order

summary:
The checkout loses or ignores the Widget quantity when the order is submitted, even though the page showed one Widget and a $20.00 total immediately before the click.
Fix checkout so it uses the quantities currently shown in the cart when Place order is clicked, then add a test that submits one Widget and expects an order confirmation.
evidence: objective_contradiction: Order submission shows “Your cart is empty” despite Widget quantity 1, so no confirmation message can be verified.
one_liner: Placing an order rejects the cart as empty even though it contains one Widget.
